types.description: S201M-B6 miniature circuit breaker, one pole, B characteristic, 6 A

document.title: System pro M compact — DIN Rail components for low voltage installation

modelingNotes: Exact S201M-B6 identity: 1 protected pole, B characteristic, In 6 A. Manufacturer diagrams preserve terminal numbers 1 and 2. Supply may enter either end; terminal roles do not impose line/load direction.

ABB PRODUCT-DETAILS at https://assets.cef.co.uk/downloads/pdg/abb_2cds271001r0065_datasheet/abb_2cds271001r0065_datasheet.pdf, pp.1-3: IEC 60898-1 voltage 230/400 V AC; IEC 60947-2 voltage 230 V AC. Maximum including tolerance 253 V AC / 72 V DC. Icn 10 kA at 230/400 V AC; Icu 15 kA and Ics 7.5 kA at 230 V AC; 50/60 Hz, reference ambient 30 °C. These are conditional capabilities, not an assigned supply or coordination approval.

Each numbered terminal represents its common wire/busbar terminal assembly. External busbars require authored connections. Auxiliary contacts and releases are separately fitted products, not integral terminals of this order.

The breaker contact has no permanent continuity. Open state follows the circuit drawing convention, not the installed handle state. Connections are application-dependent; neither is universally required. Protection behavior is not simulated.

Exact-order product sheet lists Ics 7.5 kA at 230 V AC; the 2014 S200M family table lists 11.2 kA for In <=40 A. The revision/standard-condition discrepancy is not reconciled; no scalar interrupting capacity is encoded.

connectionCoverage.notes: Both numbered power terminal assemblies, 1 and 2, are represented. Wire/busbar entries belong to their respective numbered terminal. The base breaker has no integral neutral, PE/bond, shield, signal, release or communication connection; separately ordered accessories are outside this identity.

1.description: Terminal 1, either supply or outgoing end

2.description: Terminal 2, opposite end of protected pole; either supply or outgoing end
